decision: Use the user-provided four-layer Memory Pyramid as an additive lifecycle overlay on Sourceborn typed memory and the Segment/Container/Parameter graph.
seg_con_parameter_integration: Event encoding activates Segment/Container/Parameter structures into Node-Brain working memory; accepted results are stored as typed persistent memory and retrieved into later Events.
hard_invariants: Memory Pyramid temporal stages are not new primitive memory types.
Working memory does not automatically persist.
Persistent memory does not automatically become truth.
Retrieval frequency does not strengthen independent evidence.
Closed Sequences remain immutable during memory reactivation.
Procedural learning does not silently mutate executable code.
Pattern learning does not automatically create a new Human parameter.
Source lineage remains attached through encoding, storage and retrieval.
